subject: Initial DPA intake: eSign options and data residency for Shoreline Analytics
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@shorelineanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: DPA intake and eSign options for Shoreline

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — Shoreline is moving quickly on a small pilot and legal asked me to kick off DPA intake so we can get procurement lined up. Quick asks up front:

- Can you send your current DPA template?
- Do you support DocuSign and AdobeSign (we prefer DocuSign)?
- We need to confirm data residency options for EU customers — do you offer EU-only processing or regionally-scoped controls?
- Please include a current subprocessors list and whether you have SCCs or transfer mechanisms documented.

I've attached our standard intake questionnaire for context (Shoreline_DPA_Questionnaire.pdf). Procurement is contracts@shorelineanalytics.com.

Appreciate a quick reply so we can schedule legal review this week.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of IT Security
Shoreline Analytics

Attachment: Shoreline_DPA_Questionnaire.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@shorelineanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T11:30:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA intake and eSign options for Shoreline

Hi Liam — thanks for sending the questionnaire. Looping in Karthik (legal) and Ben (CS ops) to own intake and subprocessor details.

Short answers:
- I'll attach our current Master DPA (Redwood_Master_DPA_v1.0.docx) for your review.
- We fully support both DocuSign and AdobeSign for execution; DocuSign is what our legal team uses by default.
- We offer an EU processing option for customers that require regionally-restricted processing (physical and logical controls). We can scope that in the DPA as an option; Ben can provide the hosting-region specifics.
- Our subprocessors list and transfer mechanisms are documented on the compliance portal. I'll paste the link below and also attach the current snapshot. If Shoreline needs SCCs applied per-subprocessor, Karthik will advise on the language.

Proposed next steps:
1) Karthik will review your questionnaire and let us know if there are any non-standard clauses.
2) If Shoreline prefers to redline our template, please send it back as a Word file and we'll review.
3) We can prepare a DocuSign envelope and route it to contracts@shorelineanalytics.com once redlines are resolved.

Links: Subprocessors & transfers — https://compliance.redwoodinference.com/subprocessors (internal link)
DocuSign envelope (placeholder to be created after redline)

Attachments: Redwood_Master_DPA_v1.0.docx, data-flow-diagram.png (high-level)

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@shorelineanalytics.com>
Date: 2025-08-20T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA intake and eSign options for Shoreline

Thanks Grace — I'll take the lead on the DPA review. Liam, copying you to keep legal in the loop. A couple of items from a legal perspective after a quick pass of the Redwood master: 

- Data residency: We can offer EU-only processing as an option but need to pin the regions/services that are excluded from cross-border processing (we usually list specific compute regions). Ben, can you confirm which services can be scoped to EU-only and which cannot (e.g., centralized analytics/metrics pipelines)?
- Subprocessors: we'll share the current snapshot; if Shoreline requests per-subprocessor SCCs, that will require a brief internal exception and timeline.
- Execution: We prefer DocuSign for audit trail and envelope reuse, but AdobeSign is acceptable. If Shoreline will redline our template, please send the Word file; we'll turn around first-pass comments within 3 business days.

Liam — can you confirm procurement contact (contracts@shorelineanalytics.com is good) and whether you have any mandatory wording (e.g., insurance minima, audit rights cadence) in your standard annex? If so, point me to the section in the questionnaire and we'll address those items specifically.

Grace/Ben — once we have Shoreline's redline, I'll prepare a comparison and propose limited non-negotiables for production SLOs and data transfer controls.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@shorelineanalytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@shorelineanalytics.com
Date: 2025-08-20T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA intake and eSign options for Shoreline

Thanks Karthik — that sounds good. Procurement confirms contracts@shorelineanalytics.com. Our legal will redline your Master DPA and return a Word version to you; please expect Shoreline_DPA_Initial_redlines.docx to arrive from contracts@shorelineanalytics.com later today.

Two clarifications from our side:
1) EU-only processing will be important for our EU customers; we can describe the requirement as "customer data will not be transferred out of the EU for processing" where applicable. If you can provide the list of services that are eligible for that option, that will help.
2) We prefer DocuSign. Please prepare an envelope and set the routing to contracts@shorelineanalytics.com and liam.oconnor@shorelineanalytics.com once redlines are incorporated/acknowledged.

Attachment: Shoreline_DPA_Initial_redlines.docx

Best,
Liam

- Karthik will review the Shoreline redline (received) and produce a first-pass comment set within 3 business days.
- Ben will produce a short table of which Redwood services can be scoped to EU-only and which cannot; I'll attach that to the legal response.
- We'll prepare a DocuSign envelope and share the envelope link with contracts@shorelineanalytics.com and liam.oconnor@shorelineanalytics.com after we've agreed the redline path.

For transparency, here are the two links we'll reference in the legal packet:
- Proposed DocuSign envelope (created after redline): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/SAMPLE-ENVELOPE-ID-12345
- High level dataflow diagram (shared): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxx-shoreline-dataflow-sample
